style: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original aquarium animal cutout for a mobile game and 3D modelling reference. Photorealistic natural-history specimen photograph with credible anatomy, natural small eyes, authentic skin/scales microtexture and restrained wet highlights, soft upper-left daylight. Single whole living animal, neutral straight swimming pose, head pointing RIGHT tail LEFT unless otherwise specified, every fin and tail fully visible, 10% empty padding on all sides, square 1024x1024. Genuine transparent alpha background. NOT cartoon, NOT chibi, NOT an illustration or plastic render, no human expression, no oversized eyes, no water, bubbles, scenery, ground, shadows, text or watermark. Even soft diffuse daylight from above: NO painted specular highlight streaks, glare bands or white shine patches on the back or flanks. Natural countershading — back darker, belly lighter — and the back colour continues all the way to the top edge of the body. Clean natural silhouette edge with no dark outline stroke or halo. All fins fully spread and complete: pectoral fin drawn in its natural relaxed pose swept back along the body, fin membranes slightly translucent with visible rays. Mouth closed with the mouth line clearly visible (unless the subject says open). Eye painted naturally — it stays painted on the texture.
